_doc: Ported M_CharV2_Com base-pass variants (research/roster/Port_CharV2.md). An MI matches a variant only by base_pass_ps_hash (TBasePassPSFNoLightMapPolicy on FGPUSkinPassthroughVertexFactory, SM5 High map, resolved through the MI parent chain); no static_switches fallback is given because the V2 switch space is too wide for a subset match to be safe. All other V2 MIs stay material_unported:M_CharV2_Com.
